title: Google Ads Benchmarks for YOUR Industry [Updated!]

facts.fact: Dating & Personals has an average search click-through rate of 6% in Google Ads, according to WordStream's client data.
facts.quote: boasting an average search CTR of 6%!

facts.fact: WordStream reported that legal services had an average CTR of 1.35% when it first collected the data in 2015.
facts.quote: with a relatively low average 1.35% CTR

facts.fact: WordStream's data shows the average Google Ads click-through rate across all industries is 3.17% for search and 0.46% for display.
facts.quote: The average click-through rate in Google Ads across all industries is 3.17% for search and 0.46% for display.

facts.fact: WordStream's table lists the average search CTR for Technology at 2.09% and for Dating & Personals at 6.05%.
facts.quote: | Technology | 2.09% | 0.39% |

facts.fact: WordStream states that as of 2018, the industries with the lowest average click-through rates included Technology, B2B, and Consumer Services.
facts.quote: As of 2018, the industries with the lowest average click-through rates including Technology, B2B, and Consumer Services.

facts.fact: WordStream's table lists the average Google Display Network CTR for Real Estate at 1.08%, the highest GDN CTR among listed industries.
facts.quote: | Real Estate | 3.71% | 1.08% |

facts.fact: WordStream reports the average Google Ads cost per click across all industries is $2.69 for search and $0.63 for display.
facts.quote: The average cost per click in Google Ads across all industries is $2.69 for search and $0.63 for display.

facts.fact: WordStream says the earlier averages, from a couple of years before, were $2.32 CPC for search and $0.58 for display.
facts.quote: (when the averages were $2.32 and $0.58 respectively)

facts.fact: WordStream states that average CPCs in the legal industry are over $6.
facts.quote: Average CPCs in the legal industry are over $6.

facts.fact: WordStream reports a Consumer Services average CPC of $6.40.
facts.quote: with an average CPC of $6.40.

facts.fact: WordStream attributes Advocacy's cost per click under $2 to the $2 maximum CPC bid that Google Grant advertisers must set on keywords.
facts.quote: likely as a result of the $2 max CPC bid

facts.fact: WordStream's table lists the average search CPC for E-Commerce at $1.16, the lowest search CPC among the listed industries.
WordStream states that Dating & Personals is the only industry with average Display Network cost per click over $1.
facts.quote: The only industry with costs per click over $1 on the Display network is Dating & Personals.

facts.fact: WordStream reports the average Google Ads conversion rate across all industries is 3.75% for search and 0.77% for display.
facts.quote: The average conversion rate in google ads across all industries is 3.75% for search and 0.77% for display.

facts.fact: WordStream reports that Dating & Personals has average search conversion rates over 9%.
facts.quote: with search conversion rates on average over 9%!

facts.fact: WordStream's table lists the average search conversion rate for Dating & Personals at 9.64%.
facts.quote: | Dating & Personals | 9.64% | 3.34% |

facts.fact: WordStream's table lists the average search conversion rate for Legal at 6.98%.
WordStream's table lists the average search conversion rate for E-Commerce at 2.81%.
WordStream's benchmark article covers average Google Ads metrics for twenty industries.
facts.quote: You’ll find averages across these ads metrics for twenty industries

facts.fact: The WordStream article was originally published on February 19, 2016.
The average Google Ads CPA across all industries is $48.96 for search campaigns (WordStream's median figure).
facts.quote: The average CPA in google ads across all industries is $48.96 for search and $75.51 for display.

facts.fact: Autos had the lowest average search CPA across industries, at $33.52 per action, per WordStream's benchmark table.
facts.quote: The lowest cost per action across industries is now autos, coming in at just $33 per action.

facts.fact: Technology had the highest average search CPA in WordStream's benchmark table, at $133.52.
Real estate's average search CPA in WordStream's benchmark table is $116.61.
B2B's average display (GDN) CPA in WordStream's benchmark table is $130.36.
WordStream's benchmark sample covers 14,197 US-based client accounts across all verticals.
facts.quote: This report is based on a sample of 14,197 US-based WordStream client accounts in all verticals (representing over $200 million in aggregate Google Ads spend)

facts.fact: WordStream's benchmark sample represents over $200 million in aggregate Google Ads spend.
facts.unit: million USD (minimum, aggregate Google Ads spend)
facts.quote: (representing over $200 million in aggregate Google Ads spend)

facts.fact: Each industry in WordStream's benchmark includes at minimum 30 unique active clients.
facts.quote: Each industry includes at minimum 30 unique active clients.

facts.fact: WordStream's benchmark data was collected from advertisers on Google's Search and Display networks between August 2017 and January 2018.
facts.quote: who were advertising on Google’s Search and Display networks between August 2017 and January 2018.

facts.fact: WordStream's benchmark 'averages' are medians rather than means, to offset outliers.
facts.quote: “Averages” are technically median figures to account for outliers.

facts.fact: WordStream's benchmark omits advertisers that bid exclusively on branded terms.
facts.quote: The figures omit advertisers who were exclusively bidding on branded terms.

facts.fact: WordStream's benchmark conversion figures follow a last paid click attribution model.
facts.quote: All these conversion figures follow a last paid click attribution model.
